major_awards.details: Highest civilian award instituted in 1954. Conferred upon 5 illustrious personalities: 1. Karpoori Thakur (former Bihar CM, champion of social justice - posthumous), 2. Lal Krishna Advani (former Deputy PM), 3. P. V. Narasimha Rao (former PM who pioneered 1991 economic reforms - posthumous), 4. Chaudhary Charan Singh (former PM and champion of farmers - posthumous), 5. Dr. M. S. Swaminathan (Father of India's Green Revolution - posthumous).
India's highest award in the field of cinema presented annually at National Film Awards. Latest recipients: Waheeda Rehman (53rd recipient) and Mithun Chakraborty (54th recipient).
India's highest literary honour presented by Bharatiya Jnanpith. Jointly conferred upon: 1. Gulzar (renowned Urdu poet and lyricist), and 2. Jagadguru Rambhadracharya (Sanskrit scholar and polyglot).

sports_highlights.champion: India (Defeated South Africa by 7 runs in the final at Kensington Oval, Barbados)
sports_highlights.key_facts: India won its second T20 World Cup title (first was in 2007 under MS Dhoni). Captain: Rohit Sharma; Player of the Series: Jasprit Bumrah; Player of the Match in Final: Virat Kohli (76 runs). India remained undefeated throughout the tournament.

sports_highlights.highlights: Carlos Alcaraz won French Open and Wimbledon 2024. Jannik Sinner won Australian Open and US Open 2024. Aryna Sabalenka won Australian Open and US Open 2024.
